text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Everyone in Japan~! I love ya~! Everyone 
in France~! Je vous aime~! Everyone on 
Planet Golshi~! Popato-Afuu~☆!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Watching Gold Ship beam playfully at the 
audience across the entire universe, I 
once again reflected deeply on the 
tremendous feat she had accomplished—

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
—Told ya, didn't I? That I'd grant your 
wish.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"A wild beast, whimsical, unorthodox— 'You 
never know what she'll do in the next 
second.' That is the Umamusume, Gold 
Ship."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Looking back, it had always been this way 
ever since we first met. She never makes 
sense, and she always exceeds my wildest 
imagination.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"That is precisely why I always find 
myself expecting so much."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"I thought, 'Perhaps this girl could 
achieve something delightfully unexpected, 
something beyond even my imagination'—"

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Hey, don't just stand there with a face 
like the underside of a stingray! Bow 
down, praise, and shower the glorious 
Golshi-sama with all your love already!
choice_data_list:
Incredible! This is one for the history 
books!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Mm, you may rise☆ Encore s'il vous plaît☆

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Oh, you said it! Alright, parade time! 
Winning the Arc means a victory parade, 
after all!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Veuillez préparer tous les crabes 
disponibles !

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Je veux remplir les Champs-Élysées de 
crabes.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Alright, I'll leave booking the entire 
Champs-Élysées to you, Trainer!
choice_data_list:
(I have a bad feeling I'm about to get 
into trouble again!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
For a moment, I wondered if I could still 
pretend to be a stranger and slip away 
from here, but—

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Stick with me, and I'll make your life a 
whole lot more entertaining from here on 
out.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Put that way, I had no choice but to give 
in and nod obediently.
